title: Rising Multi-Armed Bandits with Known Horizons
abstract: arXiv:2602.10727v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rising Multi-Armed Bandits (RMABs) model sequential decision problems where each arm's expected reward improves with repeated pulls. In such problems, the value of investing in an arm depends on how much time remains, making knowledge of the horizon useful side information, yet its benefit remains underexplored. We investigate this benefit through CURE-UCB, a horizon-aware algorithm that estimates each arm's cumulative reward over the remaining horizon. Theoretically, under structured assumptions, we prove that CURE-UCB uniformly dominates a representative horizon-agnostic algorithm and show that the advantage of horizon awareness can be substantial: on some instances, CURE-UCB incurs only $O(1)$ regret whereas the horizon-agnostic algorithm suffers $\Omega(T)$. Furthermore, we establish a regret upper bound for the general concave rising bandit setting whose growth-dependent term matches the known lower bound in its dependence on $T

translated_title: 已知时间范围下的上升型多臂老虎机
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.10727v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：上升型多臂老虎机（RMABs）刻画了一类序贯决策问题，其中每个臂的期望收益会随着重复拉取而不断提升。在这类问题中，对某个臂进行投资的价值取决于剩余时间的多少，因此知晓时间范围（horizon）是一种有用的辅助信息，然而其带来的收益尚未得到充分研究。我们通过 CURE-UCB 来探究这一收益，该算法能够感知时间范围，并估计每个臂在剩余时间范围内的累积收益。在理论上，在结构化假设下，我们证明了 CURE-UCB 一致地优于一个具有代表性的不依赖时间范围的算法，并表明感知时间范围的优势可能十分显著：在某些实例上，CURE-UCB 仅产生 $O(1)$ 的遗憾，而时间范围无关的算法则会遭受 $\Omega(T)$ 的遗憾。此外，我们针对一般凹型上升老虎机设定建立了遗憾上界，其中与增长相关的项在与 $T$ 的依赖关系上与已知下界相匹配。
tldr: 提出感知时间范围的 CURE-UCB 算法，证明在上升型多臂老虎机中利用已知时间范围信息可显著降低遗憾（某些实例上从 $\Omega(T)$ 降至 $O(1)$），并为一般凹型上升老虎机建立了与已知下界相匹配的遗憾上界。
en_tdlr: Proposes CURE-UCB, a horizon-aware algorithm for rising multi-armed bandits, showing that known horizon information can substantially reduce regret (from $\Omega(T)$ to $O(1)$ on some instances) and establishing a regret upper bound matching the known lower bound for general concave rising bandits.
